hypothesis: An externally supplied causal action-symmetry relation lets the existing fixed-budget PublicCausalCells reuse actual source interventions in untrained target contexts, but an exact raw-event retrieval comparator with the same information should match the transfer adapter.
substrate_state: 16 addresses, 128 learned bytes, 164-byte integrity checkpoint, each action requires public outcome
transfer_admission: Only an independent typed map (target retained address -> observed source active address, action flip bit), supplied with identical contents to all eligible methods. The map itself contains structural knowledge; its origin is synthetic authored fixture and must never be described as learned or Qwen-derived.
objective: Check feasibility of read-only native source-to-target relation transfer without editing original model/checkpoints and measure whether any advantage survives information-matched retrieval.

fixtures.action_effects: deterministic binary reward with source-optimal action derived by SHA256 from seed/source index; target-optimal action source-optimal XOR externally supplied flip-bit; scoring evaluator only
fixtures.mixed_context_control: two target flip-bits inverted per seed by fixed rule target%2==0
fixtures.claims: Synthetic intervention fixture; external labels are known from the generator but not accessible to adapter
fixtures.license: Author-created deterministic fixture with no third-party training text or model output

comparators: native transfer via PublicCausalCells plus exact typed structural map
strong exact raw-event retrieval with identical map and all public events
native original independent retained cells with no source transfer
shuffled typed relation map (2 of 4 flip bits inverted)
measured_metrics: 32 target actions per method across fixed seeds
accuracy and coverage, abstention counted incorrect for accuracy
conflicting new source evidence updates target decision, no stale cache
128 learned bytes, 164 checkpoint bytes, external map bytes separately accounted
wall-clock and complete event counts, no performance win claimed from single timing

fixed_classification.DEV_INTERFACE_PARITY_ONLY: native transfer=32/32 and exact retrieval=32/32, shuffled map<=16/32, native-no-transfer coverage=0/32, retention and interference=32/32, contradiction update changes mapped action. This is interface feasibility, NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
fixed_classification.DEV_NEGATIVE: Any frozen functional criterion fails or transfer is worse than exact retrieval.
fixed_classification.SCIENTIFIC_PASS: NOT AVAILABLE on synthetic DEV fixtures even if accuracy=100%; no gain over strongest equal-information comparator

stop_rule: Run the fixed fixtures once; preserve negative/parity outcomes; do not retune mapping/scoring after result. Further science must use independently sourced consequential causal relationships and disjoint worlds with a true learning baseline.
baseline_receipt: F09 direct ICA numerical transfer NO_GO under unverified rights; this F10 is a different independently authored concept-graph transfer concept, not a numerical donor transplant.
authority: External DEV contributor lane, read-only existing native learner with isolated wrapper and no official loop authority
